**In one line**: According to Industrial Cyber, Anthropic has teamed up with security firms on a program to protect industrial control environments such as power and manufacturing systems.

### Key points
- The initiative is called the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program.
- It targets operational technology (OT): the control systems that run physical processes in sectors such as energy, water and manufacturing.
- Multiple security firms are reported to take part as partners. The original report has the list of participants and the details of the support on offer.

### Why it matters
AI models are getting better at analyzing code and finding vulnerabilities, and that has raised concern that attackers could use the same skills. OT systems often go years without patches, and a failure can cause physical harm. The program looks like an effort by an AI developer to give defenders these capabilities first.
